DATA_WARNING: Documents are SYNTHETIC specimens rendered by scripts/make_documents.py; no real identity documents were used. The tampering is genuine image manipulation, so the ELA artifact is a real JPEG codec effect — but these scores demonstrate a correct ELA implementation against splice-and-resave tampering, NOT robustness against a forger who re-encodes the whole document uniformly, which erases the signal. ELA is a cheap first filter, never a sole control.

method.key_statistic: block_ratio — worst tile residual over the document median, because tampering is local

hotspot_localisation_note: Share of tampered held-out documents where the highest-residual tile lands on the edited field. Guards against scoring well for the wrong reason.
